notes: No accepted source file changed during the clean rebase. Shared changes from main retain all final desktop hashes and both native captures.

Picade runs are serial, with the existing kiosk match paused. No competing benchmark process was present. The original match was resumed after measurements; installed kiosk binaries and settings were not replaced.

Three 30-second samples alternate dirt shapes across stationary rigid, moving rigid, moving wheels, and footing-enabled wheels. Remaining activation/destruction/scripted cases are single smoke measurements.
Report complete update time, not rendered FPS or isolated controller overhead. Moving tanks change impacts and debris workloads. Temperature/frequency/throttle readings are endpoints around each run.

Detailed frozen reports match exactly between x86_64 ci and AArch64 release, including controller histories, every trace and shot, and final observation hashes. Both prefix native captures also match the accepted build.
Physical cabinet feel remains a human follow-up; automated control mapping and both-renderer lifecycle tests passed on the desktop.
